question: Does a data-derived full 2x2 block-output metric coordinate the individually descending c_fc and c_proj production directions better than both the production step and a diagonal output-metric control at constant materialized-update norm?
authorization: One zero-persistent-update metric-estimation and held-out-validation analysis only. No training run, optimizer change, HyperConnection, residual-topology change, or larger-rung experiment is authorized by this plan.

protocol.production_direction: Extract the exact historical optimizer update for c_fc and c_proj once from train_seed. Require each task-gradient dot update to be negative and exact singleton/joint tensor composition to have zero error.
protocol.metric_estimator: On disjoint metric windows, form each family's finite block-output delta at production scale. Average the 2x2 Gram of normalized output-delta inner products over batches and probe layers. Do not use calibration CE to choose coefficients.
protocol.solve: Solve (G + lambda I)a = -g_dot for the full metric and divide by diag(G + lambda I) for the diagonal control. Choose deterministic minimal damping for condition number at most 100, then normalize both coefficient vectors to the production total materialized Frobenius-update budget.
protocol.heldout_validation: Evaluate only production [1,1], frozen full-metric coefficients, and frozen diagonal-metric coefficients on untouched validation windows with paired batch statistics.
protocol.power_design: Use 256 held-out pairs, matching the powered scalar-response diagnostic, with a conservative two-sided 99% interval and an every-window sign requirement. All seeds are new after invalid attempt 1.
protocol.exact_restore: Keep device-resident base weights and updates; restore every BF16 tensor by exact copy before and after each temporary point. Persist zero parameter updates to the checkpoint.

decision_rule.full_metric_supported: Full metric candidate-minus-production and full-minus-diagonal 99% CI upper bounds are both below zero, and both comparisons have negative mean in every held-out window.
decision_rule.diagonal_only_supported: Full metric does not pass both gates, but diagonal-minus-production passes the same 99% and every-window gate.
decision_rule.metric_rejected: Neither registered metric candidate passes its required held-out gate; return to generator representational capacity rather than adding residual topology.
decision_rule.architecture_gate: No outcome directly authorizes HyperConnection or a residual-topology change.

execution.monitoring: direct foreground polling only; no watchdog, callback, queue worker, or heartbeat
